title: Remarkable ionic thermoelectric performance of high-entropy gel thermocell near room temperature
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2559-2569
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04247F, Paper
Lijuan Yang, Jiawei Chen, Cheng-Gong Han, Yongbin Zhu, Chunxia Xie, Zhenbang Liu, Haoyu Wang, Yu Bao, Dongxue Han, Li Niu
A concept of high-entropy was introduced in ionic thermoelectric gels through multi-ions interactions. Adding multi-ions rearranged the hydration shell of redox couples, boosting reaction entropy change and resulting in a remarkable performance.
